technical.summary: EOG shows solid structural bullish alignment across moving averages and trend indicators, but overbought short-term conditions, weak ADX, negative CMF, and absence of fresh entry signals limit swing trade probability.

fundamental.summary: EOG shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 22 days creating elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (19/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional activity (small purchases 9-21 months old, junior members) and absent recent news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis level 344.6, rising DXY, imminent CPI event) creates severe headwinds for EOG; earnings in 22 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with supertrend bullish and Ichimoku above cloud provides structural upside bias, while extreme fear (19/100) offers contrarian entry opportunity in energy sector.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought RSI/StochRSI with falling momentum, negative CMF distribution signal, weak ADX trend confirmation (17.16), macro crisis conditions (inverted yield curve, VIX 34.6, rising DXY), and earnings event risk in 22 days create excessive headwinds that outweigh technical setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure is bullish (price above MAs, supertrend, Ichimoku), but overbought momentum with negative distribution signals and weak trend confirmation undermine entry quality. Extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, rising DXY) and earnings event risk in 22 days create excessive headwinds that outweigh contrarian fear opportunity.
decision.primary_risk: Macro crisis conditions (inverted yield curve, VIX 34.6, rising DXY) combined with imminent earnings (22 days) create dual event risk that can trigger sharp reversals despite bullish technical setup.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — technical, fundamental, risk, and debate agents all converge on bear case; only sentiment offers contrarian signal but insufficient to override macro and event risks
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding 41 Energy positions and existing EOG position; sector concentration is high, further reducing conviction for new/additional exposure.
